rules.question: How is a file written so a reader never sees half of it?
rules.note: A file opened with trunc is written in place, so a stop mid-write leaves half a file. Shipped code writes through write_file_replacing instead; the library file swap (store/upgrade_files.cpp) has its own renames and recovery and opens nothing with trunc. Decided by: D114 item 20, concept audit M74.

rules.question: Is the stored score-range int points or scores?
must_not_match: if (search_depth_mode() == DepthMode::Points) return score + depth_value < best;
rules.note: 1 is points and any other int is scores; Settings::search_depth_mode says so once and Settings::lens files the result of it, so a reader that re-decides the unit from the raw int would split from the lens. It cannot flag a missing normalisation. Decided by: concept audit M14.
